# Piyush Khanna

> Software and Applied AI engineer specialising in IoT, harness engineering,
> and robotics. Founder & CEO of Emperia Smart Solutions, building embodied
> AI and home-automation hardware. This site is a personal portfolio:
> engineering projects, press coverage, and long-form writing.

Primary site: https://piyushkhanna.space
Contact: via the contact form at https://piyushkhanna.space/#contact
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/piyush-khanna-qmb/
GitHub: https://github.com/piyush-khanna-qmb/
Resume (PDF): https://piyushkhanna.space/resume.pdf

## Projects

- [Emperia Omni](https://piyushkhanna.space/project/omni): Natural-language
  to native mobile automation — an LLM-driven alternative to IFTTT/Tasker.
- [Anushka: The Humanoid](https://anushkathehumanoid.com): Humanoid robot
  with face/object/gesture recognition and multilingual speech interaction.
- [Sunaina Robot](https://piyushkhanna.space/project/sunaina): Animatronic
  robotic Durga, presiding figure at Chakraberia Sarbojanin Durgotsab,
  Kolkata, Durga Puja 2025.
- [DadaShree Robot](https://piyushkhanna.space/project/dadashree): Wisdom-tree
  robot deployed at Parasdham, a Jain monastery in Junagadh, Gujarat.
